project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA (restaurant POS/delivery admin + rider app), Supabase backend, shadcn/ui + Tailwind
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react-swc; `npm run build` runs `vite build` (Rollup). SWC strips types so there is NO separate tsc type-check gate — Rollup fails only on missing-export/binding errors. `npm run lint` = eslint. No package script runs tsc.
test_framework: vitest is configured (package.json `test`) but no tests exercise the subscription/store flows; verification is `npm run build` exit 0 + manual route sanity. Do not add a new test framework.
test_command: npm run build  (primary gate); npm run lint (secondary)

Admin env-var auth: VITE_SUB_ADMIN_EMAIL (fallback amenterprises1105@gmail.com), VITE_SUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD (fallback Ashu@1107). RPC secret: VITE_ADMIN_RPC_SECRET (fallback Ashu@1107), validated server-side against DB setting app.admin_rpc_secret (value 'Ashu@1107'). Generated file src/integrations/supabase/types.ts is AUTO-GENERATED ('Do not edit it directly') and does NOT list module_orders/subscription_* tables, so ALL new-table queries must use `.from("table" as any)` and RPCs must use `(supabase as any).rpc("name", {...})` — matching the existing useModuleOrders.ts pattern.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md only states: decode failed rider-creation responses through getFunctionErrorMessage and show recoverable errors inside the form; keep server password protections enabled. General rules from this workflow: keep free routes free, keep env-var admin auth, keep LockedRoute working, use TS interfaces (no any except the established `as any` on table names/RPCs), use existing shadcn/ui + lucide-react, loading/error/empty states + responsive mobile-first, form validation on checkout, never trust client prices.
key_patterns: Supabase query: `import { supabase } from "@/integrations/supabase/client"; supabase.from("module_orders" as any).select("*")`. RPC: `(supabase as any).rpc("update_order_status", { p_secret, p_order_id, p_status })`. Realtime: `supabase.channel(name).on("postgres_changes", {event, schema:"public", table, filter}, cb).subscribe()` + `supabase.removeChannel(channel)` in cleanup. Toast: `import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast"` (or `import { toast } from "@/hooks/use-toast"`). Context: `import { useSubscription } from "@/contexts/SubscriptionContext"`. Admin pages wrap content in `AdminLayout` (Firebase admin gate) AND add their own env-var LoginForm gate (sessionStorage "sub_auth"). Cart via sessionStorage "feature_store_cart". shadcn components import from `@/components/ui/*`.
